commit.message:
Extend IGV dump test coverage

- Cover all print levels (-1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6)
- Check level-specific phases explicitly: Final Code at level 1+,
  PhaseCCP 1 only at level 2+, After Iter GVN Step only at level 5+
- Verify graph counts increase monotonically across levels
- Parse XML with javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilder to verify
  well-formedness (catches truncated/malformed output)
- Verify compiled method name appears in graph output
- Exercise multiple methods (compute + branchyMethod) and verify
  both appear as separate groups in the dump
- Test per-method IGVPrintLevel compiler directive with system
  level 0 to ensure directive-based dumping works independently

8370870: IGV: add simple regression tests for graph dumping

Add JTReg test that exercises IGV graph dumping at different
PrintIdealGraphLevel values and verifies the basic structure of
the generated XML files:

- Expected XML elements are present (graphDocument, group, graph,
  nodes, edges, controlFlow, method, bytecodes, properties)
- Higher print levels produce more phase dumps
- Output file is non-empty and well-formed
